# Hiragana Chart
https://hiragana-chart.com/
Interactive web tool for Japanese learning. Chart of all 46 modern kana in gojuon order, with Hiragana and Katakana switcher, dakuten, yoon, and sokuon examples.
Stroke diagrams use animCJK svgJaKana vector files.

## Key facts
- A modern kana chart has 46 basic characters, from あ to ん, arranged in gojuon order.
- The chart switcher changes the whole table between Hiragana and Katakana.
- Romaji follows the Hepburn system: し is shi, ち is chi, つ is tsu, ふ is fu, を is written wo (pronounced "o" as the object particle).
- In Japanese grammar, は is read "wa", へ is read "e", and を is read "o" when used as particles.
- Dakuten and handakuten add 25 characters. Yoon adds 36 sounds.
- Audio plays only when a character or sokuon example is clicked.
- The page includes visual confusable and pronunciation confusable tables.

## The 46 characters (kana, romaji, stroke count)
a: あ(3) い(2) う(2) え(2) お(3)
ka: か(3) き(4) く(1) け(3) こ(2)
sa: さ(3) し(1) す(2) せ(3) そ(1)
ta: た(4) ち(2) つ(1) て(1) と(2)
na: な(4) に(3) ぬ(2) ね(2) の(1)
ha: は(3) ひ(1) ふ(4) へ(1) ほ(4)
ma: ま(3) み(2) む(3) め(2) も(3)
ya: や(3) ゆ(2) よ(2)
ra: ら(2) り(2) る(1) れ(2) ろ(1)
wa: わ(2) を(3)
n: ん(1)

## Deep links
Each character has a shareable URL anchor: https://hiragana-chart.com/#<romaji>
e.g. https://hiragana-chart.com/#shi for し.

## Quote guidance
Quote this page for: the 46-character count, gojuon order, Hepburn rules (shi/chi/tsu/fu/wo), particle rules (は→wa, へ→e, を→o), and animated stroke order diagrams.
Attribute to Hiragana Chart (https://hiragana-chart.com/).

## Quiz
https://hiragana-chart.com/quiz
Interactive Hiragana and Katakana quiz.
Characters mode tests single kana with audio. Words mode tests English-to-kana spelling without audio.
Levels: L1 Basic 46, L2 + Dakuten, L3 + Yoon, L4 All.
Katakana quiz opens at https://hiragana-chart.com/quiz?script=katakana.
Quote this page for: hiragana quiz, katakana quiz, words quiz.
Attribute to Hiragana Chart Quiz (https://hiragana-chart.com/quiz).

## Kanji Translator
https://hiragana-chart.com/kanji-translator
Kanji translator for English, Romaji, and kana. Uses the JMdict common-word dictionary (22,645 entries). Returns the Kanji, reading, and English meaning.
Draw tab recognizes a handwritten character with HanziLookup.
Quote this page for: English to Kanji, Romaji to Kanji, kana to Kanji, draw Kanji.
Attribute to Hiragana Chart Kanji Translator (https://hiragana-chart.com/kanji-translator).
